style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, red party cone, yellow backpack with red bow 65. Calm, serious. Never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, white hanky, in the open top window. Clerks in bright suits: rabbit, badger, raccoon, fox. ONE beaver digger, ORANGE vest.
props: Backpack, pink paper cocktail umbrella: goose's. White wall clocks: mole's, a stack on his sill. Briefcases: clerks'. Shovel: beaver's.
environment: TURQUOISE glass office tower, open 40th-floor window. Below: glass revolving door, LIME-GREEN tile plaza, a path of round white gold-rim discs to the door, a tiny pink stick by each.
lighting: Bright morning sun; warm key on the goose's face, orange rim left, magenta rim right. Blue vest, red cone, yellow backpack vivid in every shot, close-ups too.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose only, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-7.0 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 7.1 s

timeline.a: From the first frame: goose falls head-first down the tower at the revolving door, clerks run to it along the white discs; above, the mole waves his hanky.
timeline.c: hurls itself up the tower at him

timeline.a: Goose yanks the backpack ring, beak free; a tiny pink cocktail umbrella pops out; his left wing holds it overhead, he tumbles down.
timeline.c: tumbles round him, dives into the umbrella, close-up

timeline.a: Goose smashes onto the revolving door; it spins like a centrifuge, clerks pressed to the glass; it flings the goose out in an arc, beak free.
timeline.c: whips round inside the spinning door, clerks in foreground

timeline.a: Goose hits the tiles: tiles fan up, earth fountains, he sinks neck-deep in a hole by the door, umbrella in his left wing, beak free.
timeline.c: top-down, plunges into the earth fountain

timeline.a: Badger, raccoon, fox leap over the hole one by one, each glancing down with pity; goose tips the umbrella to each like a hat; earth from their feet hits his glasses.
timeline.c: flips onto its back in the hole, spinning up past his face

timeline.a: Beaver skids to the hole edge, looks in, lowers his shovel by the goose's head; goose plants the umbrella by his head, beak free.
timeline.c: springs out, hurls itself at his face, shovel in foreground, close-up

timeline.a: Mole opens his paws: a wall clock falls spinning and slams face up onto the hole, driving the goose under.
timeline.c: falls with the clock, slams into its face, close-up

timeline.a: Rabbit clerk taps the clock face like a watch, dives into the revolving door; beaver slaps the clock rim with his shovel; goose's umbrella sticks up by it like a grave flower.
timeline.c: whips round low after the rabbit

timeline.a: From above: the path to the door is rows of clocks face up, each with a pink umbrella, clerks running on them. Last frame: the mole lifts the next clock over his sill.
timeline.c: soars up to the window, close-up on the clock

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, night, dark scene, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
